articles.title: From resettlement colony to PG hub: How Satya Niketan was stretched beyond its limits
articles.description: Satya Niketan, once a quiet resettlement colony in Delhi, has evolved into a bustling student enclave. Following the university's expansion in 1973, the area saw a sharp rise in demand for student housing. Properties morphed as they expanded beyond original designs without the requisite approvals. This rapid transformation sparks concerns regarding structural integrity and the adequacy of local infrastructure to support the growing population.

'Our consent wasn't taken': Punjab govt objects to appointment of new HC CJ
articles.description: The Punjab cabinet passed a resolution against the Centre's appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra.  This action was taken after the Centre notified the appointment without state government consent.  Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated this violated constitutional norms and procedures.  He described the appointment as an assault on Punjab's rights by the central government.  The state government believes the Centre acted too hastily in this matter.

articles.title: Fuentes Criticises Owens Focus: Far-right pundit says she hijacked Kirk tributes; urges return to faith
articles.description: Nick Fuentes has criticized Candace Owens over her coverage of Charlie Kirk’s death, arguing that the conversation has shifted away from Kirk’s influence on young men. Fuentes said Kirk inspired followers through his faith, work ethic, family values and public message. He also condemned what he described as excessive speculation and personal investigations, urging people to resist cynicism and focus instead on conscience, goodness and the values they believe Kirk represented.

articles.description: A remarkable 1,100-acre estate on Sonoma Mountain has been sold for an astounding $38.5 million. Entrepreneurs Mark and Debra Leslie have converted this once undeveloped land into a self-sustaining retreat, pouring in $33 million for environmental restoration and diverse farming infrastructures. The property boasts a contemporary main residence with breathtaking views, showcasing the growing interest in secluded, off-grid homes in coastal California.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.description: Kim Kardashian and Kanye West attended their daughter North West's first solo music gig. The estranged couple watched the performance from separate balconies in Chicago. This solo performance follows her earlier collaborations with her father, Kanye West.

articles.title: 'Love and War' teaser to be attached to 'Ramayana'?
articles.description: Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love and War has wrapped filming and will release in 2027. The film's teaser is now planned for a November 2026 theatrical launch. This teaser will be attached to Ranbir Kapoor's upcoming film Ramayana: Part 1. The trailer for Love and War is expected to arrive in late December. Fans will finally see this epic romance unfold on the big screens in January 2027.
